name: Nova — Neural Emergence Intelligence
description: Runs the full 96-node mean-field Kuramoto connectome (same validated math as organism.physics.mean_field_kuramoto_step and organism.neuroemergence.NeuroEmergenceCore) entirely in-process in Node. Coherence R drives cognitive attention — high R = focused execution, low R = exploratory diffusion. Integrates all 24 neurochemicals and 4 training protocols from the live NeuroEmergence Core canister spec.
capabilities: pulse() — step the connectome at the 873ms heartbeat, returns coherence R
inject(chemical, dose) — neurochemical injection, Hill-equation dose response
getCoherence() — current Kuramoto order parameter R
focus(task) — derive cognitive attention mode from current coherence level
runProtocol(name, ticks) — run a named training protocol on the connectome
